scope: Additive TH18 Home Village Super Minion Long Shot delta; preserves each preceding frozen reference.
game_version: The immutable ordinary-level payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The official balance note does not identify a target client build, which remains unknown.

sources.title: Super Minion Fires a LONG SHOT!
sources.limitations: The official description establishes that the first attacks have longer range and extra damage, and that Super Minions can trigger Seeking Air Mines. It gives no numeric multiplier, counter lifecycle, projectile or collision contract.

sources.title: Changes coming to Ranked Mode & League Modifiers!
sources.limitations: The official note changes current Long Range Shots from seven to eight and range from 10 to 10.25 tiles, and says all levels received about 15% more damage. It does not state the Long Shot bonus multiplier or lifecycle.

sources.title: Pinned normalized Minion superTroop payload
sources.limitations: Provides ordinary L8–14 hitpoints and damage, base range four and one-second cadence, but no Long Shot count, range, bonus multiplier, projectile or counter lifecycle.

official_deltas.behavior: Long Range Shots increase from seven to eight and reach increases from 10 to 10.25 tiles.

opening_long_shot_count.note: Primary-sourced current number of opening Long Range Shots.

opening_long_shot_range_tiles.note: Primary-sourced current Long Range Shot reach.

opening_long_shot_damage_multiplier.note: No public numeric Long Shot bonus multiplier was found. Core deliberately uses ordinary imported damage (multiplier 1.0) as a lower-bound approximation; this is not a claim that Long Shots deal ordinary damage and must be replaced by a versioned value when available.

support.note: Core/RL/GUI share an eight-launch 10.25-tile opening range. The counter is consumed when Core creates each serialised logical projectile; damage uses the documented lower-bound fallback because the official source confirms extra damage without quantifying it.

changed_values.previous_state: catalogued-only because the extra-damage multiplier and counter lifecycle were unavailable
changed_values.replacement: eight primary-sourced 10.25-tile opening launches with a transparent ordinary-damage lower-bound fallback
changed_values.justification: The lenient integration goal permits bounded deterministic approximations only when their unsupported portion is explicit and replaceable in immutable GameData.

known_uncertainties: The current numerical Long Shot extra-damage multiplier, its level scaling and relation to the official all-level damage buff remain unknown.
No source states whether the counter is per deployment or target, reset on target loss, spent by a cancelled projectile, paused by movement, or changed by spells.
No current Long Shot projectile speed, launch timing, collision geometry, target-loss, altitude filtering, visual or tick-order contract was found.
Core uses multiplier 1.0 and consumes one counter on every serialised launch. These are documented deterministic lower-bound/lifecycle approximations, not game-exact claims.
conclusion: This delta makes the primary-sourced current range and count available across shared adapters while isolating every unresolved damage and lifecycle rule for a future sourced override.
